questions.question: What proverb does Ezekiel 18 refute?
options: 'Like the mother, so the daughter, just as the old saying goes among the people'
'The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge'
'A wise son always hears his father, but a scoffer will not listen to anyone'
'The wages of all the wicked is death, but the upright shall surely live on'
questions.answer: 'The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge'

questions.question: What principle of responsibility does Ezekiel 18 teach?
options: Only kings and rulers will answer to God for the people's sin
The soul who sins shall die; each is responsible for his own sin
No one at all can be held to account for what they have done
The children must bear the heavy guilt of their fathers' sins
questions.answer: The soul who sins shall die; each is responsible for his own sin

questions.question: Ezekiel 18 says God has no pleasure in the death of anyone, but calls people to turn and live.
Turn, and live! For I have no pleasure in the death of anyone, declares the Lord _____.
